titulo.es: Why is a 660 ton ball hanging inside this skyscraper? 🏙️
titulo.en: Why is a 660 ton ball hanging inside this skyscraper? 🏙️

descripcion.es:
Taipei 101 hides a 660 ton steel ball near the top. It is a tuned mass damper: it swings so the tower does not.

Educational video.

#howitworks #skyscraper #engineering

texto.es: There is a six hundred sixty ton steel ball hanging inside this skyscraper. On purpose.
texto.en: There is a six hundred sixty ton steel ball hanging inside this skyscraper. On purpose.

texto.es: Because a tall tower has one enemy. Wind.
texto.en: Because a tall tower has one enemy. Wind.

texto.es: Up there, a storm can push the top floors back and forth by up to a meter.
texto.en: Up there, a storm can push the top floors back and forth by up to a meter.

texto.es: The building is fine. But the people inside get seasick.
texto.en: The building is fine. But the people inside get seasick.

texto.es: You cannot make a tower that tall stiff enough. So engineers did something stranger.
texto.en: You cannot make a tower that tall stiff enough. So engineers did something stranger.

texto.es: They hung a giant ball near the top, on thick steel cables.
texto.en: They hung a giant ball near the top, on thick steel cables.

texto.es: When the wind shoves the tower one way, the ball lags behind, and pulls it back the other way.
texto.en: When the wind shoves the tower one way, the ball lags behind, and pulls it back the other way.

texto.es: The ball swings, so the building does not. It cuts the sway by up to forty percent.
texto.en: The ball swings, so the building does not. It cuts the sway by up to forty percent.

texto.es: In a typhoon in twenty fifteen, the ball swung a full meter. And the tower barely moved.
texto.en: In a typhoon in twenty fifteen, the ball swung a full meter. And the tower barely moved.

texto.es: So next time the wind howls, remember:
